title: A thorough review on Deep Learning approaches to 2D-to-3D Registration in Medical Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2611.17468v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: 2D-to-3D image registration is a key component for several medical imaging purposes such as intraoperative guidance, enabling the alignment between preoperative 3D volumes and real-time 2D images. While conventional optimisation-based methods often struggle with non-convex objectives, sensitivity to initialisation, and high computational demands, deep learning (DL) has emerged as a promising alternative, offering improved alignment robustness and the potential for real-time performance. This review provides a comprehensive analysis of DL frameworks developed to address the challenges inherent in 2D-to-3D registration. We first outline how core concepts of DL are adapted to the registration problem. We then examine recent methodological advancements from multiple perspectives, including pipeline design, architectural innovations, and domain adaptation strategies. translated_title: 医学图像中2D到3D配准的深度学习方法全面综述
translated_abstract: 2D到3D图像配准是多种医学成像应用（如术中引导）的关键组成部分，它能够实现术前3D体数据与实时2D图像之间的对齐。传统的基于优化的方法常常面临非凸目标函数、对初始化敏感以及计算需求高等难题，而深度学习（DL）作为一种有前景的替代方案应运而生，提供了更强的配准鲁棒性和实时处理的潜力。本综述对为解决2D到3D配准固有挑战而开发的深度学习框架进行了全面分析。我们首先概述了深度学习的核心概念如何适配到配准问题中，然后从多个角度考察了近期的技术进展，包括流程设计、架构创新和领域自适应策略。本综述特别关注定量评估指标，重点阐述了如何衡量配准性能。
tldr: 本综述全面梳理了医学图像2D到3D配准的深度学习方法，从流程设计、网络架构创新和领域自适应等多个角度分析了最新进展，凸显了深度学习相比传统优化方法在配准鲁棒性和实时性方面的优势。
en_tdlr: This review comprehensively surveys deep learning approaches for 2D-to-3D registration in medical imaging, analyzing recent advances in pipeline design, architectural innovations, and domain adaptation strategies that offer improved robustness and real-time potential over conventional optimization-based methods.
